capabilities.name: aletia.search
capabilities.use: Re-read a cited item to confirm a quote or date the caller may see.

inputs.name: organization, acting principal, mandate, nexus, correlation id
question and its type
inputs.source: the user or the calling skill

inputs.name: ranked results with source identifiers, timestamps, relevance, and the search log
inputs.source: governance-search-strategy, or results the user supplies with their sources

outputs.name: attributed answer
outputs.description: Direct answer, confidence and an inline citation per claim.

outputs.name: evidence bundle
outputs.description: Per item: source type, identifier, title, author, timestamp, relevance, excerpt, supported claims.

outputs.name: conflicts and gaps
outputs.description: Conflicting positions with sources and dates; sources not searched or refused.

conditions: When the answer supports a legal, financial or personnel decision, the calling skill's review conditions apply.
